TYPES.Item.chassis: Ancestry, Bloodline, Culture, Background or Calling
STARWROUGHT.Sheet.applyHint: Spend this damage on the selected or targeted tokens.
STARWROUGHT.Sheet.healHint: Restore this many Hit Points instead.
STARWROUGHT.Sheet.noConstellations: Nothing invested in yet. Drag a Talent onto the sheet and its Constellation opens itself.
STARWROUGHT.Sheet.rootOnly: No line in: needs only the Root.
STARWROUGHT.Zone.head: Head
STARWROUGHT.ZoneCrit.head: Cannot use reactions until it Recenters.
STARWROUGHT.ZoneCrit.arms: A −2 circumstance penalty to attack rolls until it Recenters.
STARWROUGHT.Action.recenterHint: Gather yourself: clear every Exposed Zone on you.
STARWROUGHT.Action.recenterText: {name} gathers up, and every Exposed Zone closes.
STARWROUGHT.Action.raiseShieldOn: {name} raises the {shield}: +{bonus} item bonus to Guard against physical Attacks until the start of their next turn.
STARWROUGHT.Section.heldHint: what you can Strike or Raise with
STARWROUGHT.Field.milestoneHint: Four Milestones make a level. The first three each grant a Milestone Talent Point, spent immediately in a Flared Constellation.
STARWROUGHT.Field.tempHint: Temporary Hit Points are spent first, are not healing, and never stack with a second pool.
STARWROUGHT.Field.heroPointsHint: Spend 1 to reroll a check. Spend all of them to refuse death.
STARWROUGHT.Field.woundedHint: Whenever your Dying ends, for any reason, this rises by 1. It clears with a night's rest.
STARWROUGHT.Field.dyingHint: At Dying 5, you die. A Recovery check at the start of each of your turns.
STARWROUGHT.Field.pointsHint: Talent Points spent in this Constellation.
STARWROUGHT.Field.nextRankHint: What the next Proficiency Rank is still waiting on.
STARWROUGHT.Field.thresholdHint: The number someone else has to beat.
STARWROUGHT.Field.loadStrainHint: Subtracted from Evade, and from any Might or Agility Skill check. Endure relieves it from Expert rank: 1 at Expert, 2 at Master, 3 at Legendary.
STARWROUGHT.Field.familiarityHint: Weapon Groups and Technical weapons you are Familiar with, from Weapon Familiarity.
STARWROUGHT.Field.flareHint: Flared. A Milestone Talent Point may be spent here.
STARWROUGHT.Field.rootHint: Root Talent. Buying it is what makes you Trained.
STARWROUGHT.Field.costMaxHint: Some actions cost a range. Strike is one action to three; Disarm is one or three, with nothing in between. Leave this blank when the cost is fixed.
STARWROUGHT.Field.choiceHint: Some Talents ask you to pick something once, and mean nothing until you have. Weapon Familiarity is the one that matters most: without an answer here, nothing knows which Weapon Group you are Familiar with, and your Handling never improves.
STARWROUGHT.Field.freeTalentPlaceholder: A Talent granted outright, no point spent
STARWROUGHT.Roll.rollHint: Roll a check in this Constellation.
STARWROUGHT.Roll.refuseDeathText: {name} spends every Hero Point they have. It is not a roll: it cannot fail, and nothing in the game can stop it. They are unconscious and stable at 0 Hit Points, and they have bought one more scene.
STARWROUGHT.Rest.title: A night's rest
STARWROUGHT.Rest.text: {name} sleeps, and recovers {hp} Hit Points. Wounded clears.
STARWROUGHT.Hint.attributes: Attributes are never bought and never rolled. They are the Talents you own, counted: points ÷ 3, rounded down, maximum +5.
STARWROUGHT.Hint.originPool: The Origin Constellation has three Roots. Ancestry, Bloodline and Culture merge into one sky, and its Proficiency Rank counts all the points across its sources.
STARWROUGHT.Hint.materialWeakness: Against the damage type its material turns poorly, a piece's Protection is reduced by 1.
STARWROUGHT.Hint.matchedHarness: Matched harness: +1 Protection on the Torso, and 1 less Load Strain.
STARWROUGHT.Hint.clatter: Clatter: two or more mail or plate pieces while the torso is neither. You are Noisy whatever the individual pieces say.
STARWROUGHT.Hint.armor: Each Zone holds one piece, bought, worn, and lost separately. Your Torso is the number that matters most, because ordinary Hits land there.
STARWROUGHT.Hint.actions: Actions and Activities this character has picked up. The full reference lives in the Actions compendium.
STARWROUGHT.Hint.grazeCost: The Graze Cost: the Zone struck becomes Exposed when this is applied.
STARWROUGHT.Hint.weaponTraits: Traits carry the rules. Agile, Finesse, Deadly d8, Two-Hand d8, Thrown 20 ft, Ranged 120, Armor-Piercing 1, Versatile P, and the rest are all read from the Trait line.
STARWROUGHT.Hint.npcThresholds: The players roll everything, so an adversary carries Thresholds rather than bonuses.
STARWROUGHT.Hint.attackThreshold: The number a player's Defense roll has to beat.
STARWROUGHT.Hint.mapSecond: Second attack: the Threshold drops by 5.
STARWROUGHT.Hint.mapThird: Third attack or later: the Threshold drops by 10.
STARWROUGHT.Prompt.deleteBody: {name} will be removed from this sheet. This cannot be undone.
STARWROUGHT.Notify.notDying: Not Dying. A Recovery check is only made while Dying.
STARWROUGHT.Notify.noHeroPoints: No Hero Points left to spend.
STARWROUGHT.Notify.noCombatant: This character is not in the current encounter.
STARWROUGHT.Notify.noActor: The Actor behind this card could not be found.
STARWROUGHT.Notify.notOwner: You do not own that character.
STARWROUGHT.Notify.noWeapon: That weapon is no longer on the sheet.
STARWROUGHT.Notify.noTarget: Select or target a token first.
STARWROUGHT.Notify.recoveryDue: {name} is Dying: make a Recovery check.
STARWROUGHT.Notify.diagonals: This copy of the system is not measuring diagonals exactly. STARWROUGHT does, so distances and Stride costs will read short. Check the grid block in system.json.
STARWROUGHT.Notify.emptyPacks: STARWROUGHT: the compendium packs are empty. Run 'node tools/build-packs.mjs' in the system folder to compile the shipped content.
STARWROUGHT.Chargen.title: Character Creation
STARWROUGHT.Chargen.startTitle: This character has not been built yet
STARWROUGHT.Chargen.startBanner: Creation in STARWROUGHT is a sequence: your Ancestry decides which Bloodlines exist, and your Background decides where its points may go. The wizard walks it one step at a time.
STARWROUGHT.Chargen.resumeBlurb: The wizard remembers where you were, and Back still unwinds the choices you made.
STARWROUGHT.Chargen.cancelBody: Every choice this wizard made comes back off the character: the Talents it added are deleted and the fields it set are cleared. The character itself is kept.
STARWROUGHT.Chargen.gotoHint: Go back to this step. Everything after it is unwound.
STARWROUGHT.Chargen.incomplete: This step still has a choice to make or a Talent Point to spend.
STARWROUGHT.Chargen.pickConstellation: Choose where this point goes, then choose a Talent.
STARWROUGHT.Chargen.autoSpent: Taken automatically: this was the only legal purchase. Becoming Trained in a Constellation you have not opened buys its Root, and there is nothing else the point could do. Use Back if you want to change the choice that granted it.
STARWROUGHT.Chargen.stuck: There is nothing legal left for this point. It is set aside, and you may move on.
STARWROUGHT.Chargen.name: Character name
STARWROUGHT.Chargen.startBlurb: STARWROUGHT is a heroic fantasy game: every character begins Trained in Weapons and in all four Defenses, free, before a single point is spent.
STARWROUGHT.Chargen.startFooter: Your next four choices grant more free Roots (your Ancestry, your Bloodline, your Culture, and your trade's Lore) before you spend anything either.
STARWROUGHT.Chargen.blurb.ancestry: The body your character was born in. It sets Hit Points per level, Size, Speed, and one special ability, and it forms the trunk of your Origin Constellation. Its Root Talent is granted free.
STARWROUGHT.Chargen.blurb.bloodline: The lineage inside the Ancestry. Its Root Talent is granted free, and some Bloodlines hand you a Talent Point of their own to spend here.
STARWROUGHT.Chargen.blurb.culture: Where you were raised, which is deliberately separate from what you were born as. Its Root grants a language and a Diplomacy bonus toward those who share it.
STARWROUGHT.Chargen.blurb.background: What happened to you before the road. Your trade grants Training in two Skills and in a Lore of its own.
STARWROUGHT.Chargen.blurb.calling: The life you chose. It grants Training in one Skill, Hit Points per level, and a signature technique that sits at the Root of its Constellation.
STARWROUGHT.Chargen.blurb.defenses: You are already Trained in all four. This point deepens one of them.
STARWROUGHT.Chargen.blurb.comets: A Comet is a Talent Point that answers to no Constellation. Spend it anywhere you qualify for, even a sky you have never touched.
STARWROUGHT.Chargen.blurb.review: Name your character and finish. Everything here is already on the sheet.
STARWROUGHT.Chargen.trainedHint: Become Trained in it: if the Constellation is not open, this point buys its Root, and that purchase is what makes you Trained.
STARWROUGHT.Chargen.loreHint: Every Lore is its own Constellation, so this one gets its own rank and grows on its own.
STARWROUGHT.Chargen.callingHint: It buys your Calling's signature technique, which sits at its Root.
STARWROUGHT.Chargen.callingSkillHint: Your Calling's free Training. If you are already Trained there, the point buys a deeper Talent instead of being wasted.
STARWROUGHT.Chargen.defenseHint: Awareness, Evade, Guard, or Endure. All four are already Trained, so this buys something deeper in one of them.
STARWROUGHT.Chargen.cometHint: Three points, anywhere you qualify for. Identity Roots are the one thing a Comet can never buy: those come from your choices, not your points.
STARWROUGHT.Chargen.grantHint: A Talent you just took hands you another point. It has to be spent before you move on.
STARWROUGHT.Chargen.choicePrompt: {talent} asks you to choose: {prompt}. Without an answer the Talent has no mechanical effect, so pick now or fill it in on the Talent's own sheet later.
STARWROUGHT.Chargen.choiceShared: {name} comes with it, free, and takes the same answer. You are only asked once.
STARWROUGHT.Chargen.freeTalentGranted: {name} was granted free, with no Talent Point spent.
STARWROUGHT.Chargen.freeTalentMissing: This Talent hands over "{name}", which is not in the Talents compendium.
STARWROUGHT.Chargen.lorePrompt: Every Lore (X) is a copy of the same template, so name the field this one covers.
STARWROUGHT.Chargen.lorePlaceholder: Circus, Warfare, the Underworld, Trade Roads
STARWROUGHT.Chargen.whyBloodlineRoot: A Bloodline Root is granted by choosing that Bloodline, never bought.
STARWROUGHT.Chargen.whyIdentityRoot: Identity Roots come from your character-creation choices, never from points.
STARWROUGHT.Chargen.whyNeedsRoot: Nothing here can be bought before {name}.
STARWROUGHT.Chargen.whyTier: {tier} is locked: you do not have the points or the level for it yet.
STARWROUGHT.Chargen.whyCapstone: A capstone needs a Master Talent in this Constellation first.
STARWROUGHT.Flare.title: Flare
STARWROUGHT.Flare.hint: A Constellation Flares on a Critical Success or Critical Failure on a roll with consequences, directly related to a Talent in it.
STARWROUGHT.Flare.prompt: Which Constellation did that belong to? It needn't be one you have opened: a Milestone Talent Point spent there buys its Root.
STARWROUGHT.Flare.message: {name} is Flared. A Milestone Talent Point may be spent there, and it stays Flared until you do.
STARWROUGHT.Carry.drawHint: Draw it. One Interact action in an encounter.
STARWROUGHT.Carry.stowHint: Put it away. One Interact action in an encounter.
STARWROUGHT.Carry.wearHint: Put it on. A minute for each point of Protection, so not during a fight.
STARWROUGHT.Carry.takeOffHint: Take it off. It goes into your gear.
STARWROUGHT.Carry.donTimeHint: Putting this piece on or taking it off takes 1 minute for each point of Protection.
STARWROUGHT.Actions.label: Actions
STARWROUGHT.Actions.reaction: Your reaction. One per round, on somebody else's turn.
STARWROUGHT.Actions.resetHint: Back to three actions and a reaction.
STARWROUGHT.Actions.notYourTurn: Not your turn. Your reaction is still yours.
STARWROUGHT.Actions.overActions: {name} did {what}, which costs {need}, with only {left} action(s) left: {over} over.
STARWROUGHT.Actions.overReaction: {name} used {what} as a reaction, but their reaction was already spent this round.
STARWROUGHT.Actions.overNote: It happened anyway. The system counts; the table decides.
STARWROUGHT.Actions.notHeld: {name} is not in hand. Draw it first.
STARWROUGHT.Actions.armorInCombat: Putting on or taking off {name} takes about {minutes} minute(s). That is not something you do in the middle of an encounter.
STARWROUGHT.Actions.strideText: {name} covers {feet} feet on a Speed of {speed}: {cost} action(s).
STARWROUGHT.Field.totalReachHint: Natural Reach {natural} ft + weapon {weapon} ft = {total} ft, measured from the edge of your space to the edge of your target's.
STARWROUGHT.Field.rangeHint: A ranged weapon: this is its range, not your reach.
STARWROUGHT.Hint.armorInCombat: An encounter is running. Armor takes minutes to put on or take off, so it is locked until the fight ends.
STARWROUGHT.Settings.trackActionsHint: Spend actions automatically for Strikes, Raise a Shield, Recenter, drawing or stowing a weapon, and moving. Only ever applies during an encounter, and the pips on the sheet can always be corrected by hand.
STARWROUGHT.Settings.showReach: Show Total Reach on the map
STARWROUGHT.Settings.showReachHint: Draw a ring at your Total Reach around the token you control or hover over. Natural Reach plus the longest melee weapon in hand.
STARWROUGHT.Settings.showStrideBands: Colour the drag ruler by Strides
STARWROUGHT.Settings.showStrideBandsHint: While dragging a token, colour the highlighted squares by which action pays for them: green for the first Stride, gold for the second, orange for the third, red for anything past what you have left to spend. Nothing is prevented; the red squares are a warning.
STARWROUGHT.Settings.autoOpenHint: When a Talent arrives on a character with no Constellation Item for it, fetch the Constellation from the compendium so the sky is drawn.
STARWROUGHT.Settings.offerFlares: Offer a Flare on a critical
STARWROUGHT.Settings.offerFlaresHint: Put a Flare button on the chat card whenever a roll criticals, so the Constellation can be lit from the table.
STARWROUGHT.Settings.trackMapHint: Open the roll dialog on the Multiple Attack Penalty step this character has actually reached, counting from the start of its turn. It is only the opening guess: a reaction neither suffers the penalty nor accrues it, so the choice stays in the dialog.
STARWROUGHT.Settings.autoRecoveryHint: Notify the owner at the start of a Dying character's turn.
